newsitem.title: USA: Conrail says suit lacks merit.
newsitem.headline: Conrail says suit lacks merit.

text.p: Conrail Inc, in its first public comment on a lawsuit by Norfolk Southern Corp seeking to block an intended merger between Conrail and CSX Corp, said the suit lacks merit.
"It's entirely without merit," a Conrail spokesman told Reuters in reference to the suit.
Norfolk Southern filed the suit in U.S. District Court for Eastern Pennsylvania late Tuesday in connection with its rival $100 per-share cash offer to acquire Conrail, revealed Wednesday.
In the suit, Norfolk Southern charged that Conrail violated Pennsylvania law and U.S. securities regulations in agreeing to the merger in its proposed form and asked the court to block the deal.
Norfolk Southern also asked for an expedited hearing on the case, and a scheduling conference with lawyers for the parties was being held on Thursday.
